categories.title: Grant Guidelines & RFPs
categories.intro: Program guidelines and requests for proposals (RFPs) describe each program's priorities, eligibility, deadlines, funding amounts, and review criteria. Read the guidelines before preparing a letter of inquiry or application.

categories.title: Application Templates & Worksheets
categories.intro: Templates and worksheets help you prepare letters of inquiry, applications, and budgets. Each is available as a fillable Word document and as a print-ready PDF.

categories.title: Grant Reporting Forms
categories.intro: Grantees use these forms to report on results. The reporting requirements for each grant are listed in the award letter and on each program page.

categories.title: Annual, Impact & Financial Reports
categories.intro: Our annual reports, community impact reports, financial summaries, and research briefs show where charitable dollars go and what they accomplish.

categories.title: Nonprofit Learning Resources
categories.intro: Practical guides from the Nonprofit Learning Hub for executive directors, development staff, and board members.

extra_questions: How are LGBTQ+ people involved in leading, staffing, or advising your organization?
How will you protect the privacy and safety of participants?

documents.title: Rising Roots Black Futures Fund: 2027 Request for Proposals
documents.description: Priorities, eligibility, the five application questions, and written or video submission options.
extra_questions: Tell us about your organization and the Black community you serve.
What do you want to accomplish with this grant, and why now?
Who will lead the work, and how is the community involved?
How will you know the work has made a difference?
How will the grant be spent? Include a simple budget.
